evidence: Advisory's 'Affected code' section explicitly names TemplateLookup.get_template() in mako/lookup.py (posixpath-based URI normalization) and Template.__init__() in mako/template.py (os.path-based traversal validation) as the two locations whose mismatched path semantics cause the traversal.
assumptions: Assumed module paths mako.lookup and mako.template map directly to the file paths mako/lookup.py and mako/template.py given in the advisory
Treated both functions as sinks since the advisory frames the vulnerability as a mismatch between the two, rather than a single flawed function
